headline.en: Inspect an agent trace at the point that matters.
headline.zh: 从关键 Span 检查 Agent 轨迹。

sub.en: ForkSpan loads recorded OTLP GenAI spans into a navigable tree and exports a StateSnapshot at a selected span.
sub.zh: ForkSpan 把记录的 OTLP GenAI Span 加载成可浏览的树，并在选定 Span 导出 StateSnapshot。

body.en: Export the recorded state at an explicit ID.
body.zh: 按明确 ID 导出记录状态。

body.en: TUI navigation and JSON output share the same trace model.
body.zh: TUI 与 JSON 输出使用同一轨迹模型。

body.en: Inspection needs no model call or remote service.
body.zh: 检查无需模型调用或远程服务。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/forkspan.git
cd forkspan
go build ./cmd/forkspan

limitations.en: fork and replay are not implemented; their current commands print roadmap guidance.
limitations.zh: fork 与 replay 尚未实现，当前命令只输出路线图说明。

limitations.en: Recorded reachability is not proof of causal responsibility. No model or tool is re-executed.
limitations.zh: 记录中的可达性不等于因果责任证明；工具和模型都不会重新执行。

limitations.en: The bundled compromised trace is synthetic and contains no live incident data.
limitations.zh: 随仓异常轨迹是合成数据，不是实时事件记录。

body.en: A suspicious tool call is easier to investigate when its parent spans and reachable downstream calls stay visible. ForkSpan turns a trace export into a local inspection surface with a scriptable snapshot path.
body.zh: 调查可疑工具调用时，需要看到上游 Span 与可达的后续调用。ForkSpan 将轨迹导出文件转成本地检查界面，并提供可脚本化的快照导出。

body.en: ingest parses the OTLP export and builds the span relationships. The TUI renders the tree, and snapshot capture collects the recorded state at the selected ID. The current fork and replay commands are roadmap placeholders; no counterfactual execution is performed.
body.zh: ingest 解析 OTLP 文件并建立 Span 关系；TUI 展示树，快照模块按选定 ID 收集记录状态。当前 fork 和 replay 命令是路线图占位，不执行反事实运行。

body.en: ingest parses the OTLP export and builds the span relationships. The TUI renders the tree, and snapshot capture collects the recorded state at the selected ID. The current fork and replay commands are roadmap placeholders; no counterfactual execution is performed.
body.zh: ingest 解析 OTLP 文件并建立 Span 关系；TUI 展示树，快照模块按选定 ID 收集记录状态。当前 fork 和 replay 命令是路线图占位，不执行反事实运行。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --list prints the recorded tree without opening a TUI. --snapshot/-s selects a span. --json writes the snapshot to stdout; --out/-o also selects a file destination. In the TUI use j/k to navigate, m to mark, s to save, and q to quit.
body.zh: --list 无需 TUI 即可打印树；--snapshot/-s 选择 Span。--json 将快照写到标准输出，--out/-o 可指定文件。在 TUI 中使用 j/k 移动、m 标记、s 保存、q 退出。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json --list
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json -s 0a0b0c0d0e0f0a0b --json
# Interactive navigation requires a terminal:
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json
